images.title: List and table
images.purpose: Show the same 10 shoe sizes as an ordered list and as a shorter frequency table.
images.composition: Ordered list of two short rows on the left, frequency table on the right, wide gap between.
images.exact_structure: Left: 2 rows of exactly 5 equal plain cards, showing 3, 3, 3, 4, 4 and 5, 5, 5, 5, 6, teal #0072B2 outlines. Right: one amber #E69F00 outlined table with 2 columns and 4 rows: sizes 3, 4, 5, 6 with frequencies 3, 2, 4, 1. Exactly 10 cards and 4 table rows.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a table whose frequencies do not total 10
any sum of the sizes themselves
images.takeaway: The same data can be shown as a long list or a short frequency table.
images.description: Ten ordered shoe-size cards in two rows of 5 on the left and a 4-row frequency table of the same data on the right.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to find where the size 5 appears in the list and where its count is in the table.

image_decisions.why: Showing the same data two ways is a picture idea; one image carries it.
